column1: # Example sentences written for this pack that serve only as word examples:
# tagged apart from the corpus, so they never move the frequency pass or
# glosses. Format: Italian<TAB>English. Reviewed by hand; they ship with
# "src": "gen" and no audio, and are exempt from the drop-everywhere
# filter (engine packbuilder README, drop_all_levels). Append only.
# il suicidio: every Tatoeba example is dropped by the cross-pack suicide policy.

column2: The government wants to reduce suicide cases.
